findings.message: This function is called rather than constructed and nothing binds `this` to it, so `this` is `undefined` here and every property read off it throws at runtime. The usual cause is a method that was moved out of a class or an object literal and left its `this.` prefixes behind. Take what it needs as a parameter, give the function a `this` parameter so TypeScript can check the call sites, or make it a method again.
